data.name: Sabbir
data.gender_notes: Sabbir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sabbir is a Hindi name with the meaning 'Bringer of Prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sabh', which means 'assembly', and the Sanskrit word 'Bir', which means 'hero'. Together, these words suggest a strong and powerful individual who brings prosperity and wealth to those around them. The name Sabbir carries the meaning “Bringer of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Sabbir usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sabbir is a spiritual name with deep meaning in Hinduism. It represents the divine power of bringing prosperity and abundance to one's life. It is a name that inspires strength, courage, and wisdom, and is often given to children who are expected to become leaders and bring positive change to their communities.
data.etymology: Sabbir belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabbir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
